{
  "pros": [
    "Open-source and transparent security model.",
    "Generous personal free tier and highly affordable premium plans.",
    "Strong encryption and robust security features.",
    "Cross-platform compatibility (desktop, mobile, browser extensions).",
    "Option for self-hosting for advanced users and organizations.",
    "Reliable password syncing across devices."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "User interface (UI) can feel less polished or modern compared to competitors.",
    "Mobile app experience can sometimes be less intuitive or smooth.",
    "Steeper learning curve for advanced features, such as team sharing or self-hosting setup.",
    "Customer support, while responsive, might not be as extensive as enterprise-focused solutions.",
    "Occasional minor issues with autofill or browser extension integration.",
    "Lack of some niche integrations or advanced reporting features found in enterprise tools."
  ],
  "changed": [
    "Changed pro #2: 'Generous free tier and highly affordable premium plans.' to 'Generous personal free tier and highly affordable premium plans.' because the note '[friction] The Free organization is limited to 2 users (including me) and 2 collections, so a 50-person team cannot be evaluated beyond a single teammate without moving to Teams.' indicates the free tier for organizations is not as generous as for individuals, warranting a clarification.",
    "Changed con #3: 'Steeper learning curve for advanced features or self-hosting setup.' to 'Steeper learning curve for advanced features, such as team sharing or self-hosting setup.' because the note '[friction] The personal vault Add menu has no Collection option; sharing requires first creating an organization from a 'New organization' link tucked into the vault filter sidebar.' directly highlights friction in setting up sharing, which is an advanced feature."
  ]
}

pros: Generous personal free tier and highly affordable premium plans.
Strong encryption and robust security features.
Option for self-hosting for advanced users and organizations.
cons: User interface (UI) can feel less polished or modern compared to competitors.
Mobile app experience can sometimes be less intuitive or smooth.
Steeper learning curve for advanced features, such as team sharing or self-hosting setup.
Customer support, while responsive, might not be as extensive as enterprise-focused solutions.
Occasional minor issues with autofill or browser extension integration.
Lack of some niche integrations or advanced reporting features found in enterprise tools.
changed: Changed pro #2: 'Generous free tier and highly affordable premium plans.' to 'Generous personal free tier and highly affordable premium plans.' because the note '[friction] The Free organization is limited to 2 users (including me) and 2 collections, so a 50-person team cannot be evaluated beyond a single teammate without moving to Teams.' indicates the free tier for organizations is not as generous as for individuals, warranting a clarification.

Changed con #3: 'Steeper learning curve for advanced features or self-hosting setup.' to 'Steeper learning curve for advanced features, such as team sharing or self-hosting setup.' because the note '[friction] The personal vault Add menu has no Collection option; sharing requires first creating an organization from a 'New organization' link tucked into the vault filter sidebar.' directly highlights friction in setting up sharing, which is an advanced feature.
